  • 掌握透過區域網路 PXE 無線部署 Windows 與 Linux 系統的實用技巧與 BIOS 設定方式。
  • 見證作者如何親自修改開源專案，修復原版工具缺陷以實現順暢的自訂映像檔安裝體驗。

將 Android 手機打造成系統開機神器

作者介紹了一款名為 NetBoot 的開源應用程式，能將 Android 手機轉變成功能齊全的系統安裝工具。使用者只需準備一台具備 Android 8.0 以上系統、取得 Root 權限 且內核支援的手機，並預先匯入 Windows 或 Linux 的 ISO 映像檔，即可免除實體 USB 隨身碟，隨時隨地為電腦進行系統安裝或維護。

第一種模式：模擬 USB 啟動隨身碟

在 USB 模式下，作者建議直接將本機的 ISO 映像檔匯入 NetBoot。點擊映像檔下方的 USB 圖示後，系統會生成開機介面。接著使用傳輸線連接手機與電腦，在電腦開機的同時於手機端確認連線，並按下主機板的開機快捷鍵進入 開機選單（Boot Menu），選擇 NetBoot 即可引導進入安裝程式。若電腦不支援快捷選單，亦可至 BIOS 修改開機順序，將 USB 設為第一開機裝置。

第二種模式：PXE 網路開機與開源改造

除了有線模式，該工具亦支援區域網路內的 PXE 網路開機。使用者需在 BIOS 中啟用 網路開機（Network Boot） 與 IPv4 PXE 支援。然而作者在實測時發現原版 Ventoy PXE 存在無法識別自訂映像檔及鍵盤無回應的瑕疵。為此，作者親自 Fork 原始碼進行改造，成功讓 PXE 模式直接讀取手機內的映像庫，並完整支援 UEFI 與 Legacy 引導模式，打造出極為便利的無線系統安裝與維護方案。

================================================

Connect your phone to your PC to launch a Windows/Linux installation directly; no USB drive is needed. Connect your phone and PC to the same network to launch installations remotely via PXE without cables. This is NetBoot, an open-source app. Just install it on your phone and import your ISO images for a convenient system installation experience. In this video, we'll use NetBoot to turn your phone into a powerful system installation tool. For preparation, we need an Android device running version 8.0 or higher. with root access; temporary root is also fine. Note that NetBoot requires kernel support, so having root alone doesn't guarantee it will work. You also need a PC that supports USB booting to perform the installation; NetBoot relies on that for system setups. Additionally, you'll need to prepare some system ISO images; NetBoot supports most of them. Following standard practice, I've put all the resources in the video description; please leave a like. Once ready, let's look at NetBoot's first mode: acting as a bootable USB drive. Install NetBoot on your phone and grant it root permissions.

. Open NetBoot to reach the homepage; it offers two modes: USB boot mode and PXE server mode. We'll take a look at using it as a bootable USB drive now. NetBoot supports downloading images online, but it's very slow, so I recommend importing ISO files directly. Locate the system ISO images stored on your phone and tap them to import. You can import all the images you need to make selecting them easier later. After importing, it looks like this. Tap the USB icon under any image; the first time you use it, it will create a boot interface. Once the. progress bar completes, it will prompt for a USB connection. This message disappears after connecting to the PC. Grab a cable to connect your phone and PC. Keep the computer off for now and leave the phone as is. For the correct sequence, press the power button on your PC first, then tap the USB connection on your phone. Ignore any pop-up windows on the phone. Press the boot menu key on your PC—it varies by model, mine is F7. Select the NetBoot option in the menu and hit Enter to boot the image and install the system.

To boot a different image, just tap the USB icon for that image after the PC starts. It can boot common images like Windows and Linux. If your computer doesn't have such a quick boot menu, you can also find the boot page in the BIOS and change the first boot priority to the USB device. After saving, you will be able to boot directly from your phone. After installation, you can disconnect the USB cable if you wish to remove it. Now that we've covered the first method, let's look at the second boot method: PXE boot . To use PXE, we need to configure some. BIOS settings first. Enter the BIOS, switch to the advanced options page, and find network boot. Press enter to access the settings, enable network boot, and then check if IPv4 PXE is also enabled. If not, enable it. Next, go back to the boot page, find the boot priority, change it to "Network," and save and exit. On your phone, make sure the system images are imported, then enter the PXE page, scroll down, and tap " Start PXE." Ensure the computer and phone are on the same local network. Turn on the computer, and it will.

automatically search for the PXE server . Once it detects your phone, wait a moment to enter the Ventoy PXE menu—and then, well, nothing happens. Damn, this Ventoy PXE function isn't quite what I expected. The menu only shows a few default images and ignores the ones I've imported. Even worse, the menu seems to have a bug and doesn't respond to keyboard inputs. Since Ventoy is an open-source project, and the original functionality isn't very good, I'll just modify it myself. I forked the Ventoy code and spent some time integrating the phone's image library with the PXE function. Ha, now starting PXE can directly read the images on your phone. The modified app looks like this. Since it's an independent installation package, you may need to grant it permissions and re-import the images before use. Similarly, we start the app, ensure the system images are correctly imported, remember to tap the PXE page, and then start PXE. Boot the computer from PXE, wait a moment, and it will scan and find our phone. After entering the PXE menu, all the Ventoy system images you imported will be displayed here. Select.

an image and press enter to start the system installation. Very convenient, right? Whether it's UEFI or Legacy, both can be booted. However, make sure your phone doesn't lose connection and don't close the PXE service during installation, as the image needs to be continuously transmitted throughout the process. So, that covers pretty much everything about this little tool, LBOT . Its USB boot feature can replace our bootable flash drives, making it very convenient to install systems while on the go. As for the PXE feature, it’s perfect for those with heavy system deployment and maintenance needs—PXE deployment is just great. If you encounter any issues while using this software later on, you can go to my GitHub page to provide feedback, and I. will definitely fix them. Alright, that's it for this video. I'm Moras, and I'll see you in the next one.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m2JBDgU7ESY

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解如何將閒置的舊 Android 手機或平板改造成低功耗、高效能的輕量級 Linux 伺服器。
  • 學習如何利用現代 AI Agent 工具自動化完成複雜的 Android 核心修補與 Docker 環境設定，大幅降低技術門檻。
  • 掌握 DroidSpaces 容器技術的安裝、存儲配置與端口轉發方法，實現穩定且不影響原機操作的背景服務部署。

摘要

DroidSpaces 簡介與前置準備

作者介紹了名為 DroidSpaces 的 Android 開源容器應用，與傳統虛擬機不同，它採用共用核心與硬體的容器技術，具備運行速度快、資源消耗低的優勢，且後台運行 Linux 時手機仍可照常使用。利用該工具，使用者可以將舊手機打造成 OpenList 文件伺服器、AsterBot AI 助理或全天候下載機。前置準備需一台 Android 8.0 以上、已解鎖 Bootloader 並取得 Root 權限的設備，以及一台運行 AI Agent 工具（如 WorkBuddy 或 Claude）的電腦以輔助編譯與配置。

修補核心與建立 Linux 容器

由於 DroidSpaces 的運行需要特定內核功能（如 PID、IPC namespace 與 devtmpfs），作者利用 WorkBuddy 搭配 DeepSeek 模型透過 USB 調試自動完成了核心的修補與刷寫。在滿足核心需求後，作者於手機上安裝了 DroidSpaces 並授權 Root，隨後在內建倉庫中下載並建立了 Ubuntu 20.04 容器。作者特別建議維持默認存儲設置，避免直接掛載手機真實目錄導致誤刪資料，並將容器空間分配為 32GB。

配置 SSH 連線與端口轉發

item.itunes:summary:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=v3U6xs2PEPE

值得閱讀的理由

  • 了解如何藉由AI 技能模組（Skill）將複雜繁瑣的黑蘋果安裝流程轉化為高度自動化的標準指引。
  • 深入體會大型語言模型在落實特定工作流程時遇到的挑戰，以及如何透過嚴格提示詞避免模型自由發揮的除錯實務。
  • 獲取已經在 GitHub 開源的黑蘋果全新解決方案，讓非技術背景的使用者也能在 AI 輔助下輕鬆上手。

摘要

靈感萌芽與通用黑蘋果方案的構想

作者受到網路上利用人工智慧成功安裝 NVIDIA 顯卡黑蘋果影片的啟發，親自嘗試並順利完成配置。然而，作者意識到單純分享特定硬體的設定過程對廣大網友助益有限，因而萌生了將整體作業流程轉化為 AI 技能（Skill） 的構想。這套機制旨在讓使用者直接將流程餵給 AI，由 AI 根據不同的引導程式進行設定與除錯，打造出一套能應對各類硬體相容性問題的通用解決方案。

九大階段流程與開源 AI 技能手冊

為了實現「只要 AI 能完成的步驟，人類就不用手動執行」的核心理念，作者將整個黑蘋果安裝過程拆解為九個階段，並將專案於 GitHub 完全開源。這份技能本質上是為 AI 量身打造的操作手冊，使用者在整個過程中只需要負責開啟遠端連線、插拔 USB 隨身碟、重開機等少數實體操作，其餘檔案配置與錯誤排查均交由 AI 主導推進。

模型執行差異的挑戰與社群協同測試

在利用 Cursor 與 GPT-4o 開發期間，作者發現不同大型語言模型的執行與理解能力落差極大，甚至時常脫稿演出，導致作者花費整整一週、反覆迭代超過十個版本來約束模型行為。雖然該技能在作者手邊的設備上運行順利，但因個人硬體環境與 Token 資源有限，作者（Moras）誠摯邀請廣大社群共同參與測試並至 GitHub 反饋問題，攜手完善這套黑蘋果安裝技能。

================================================

The purpose of this SG is simple: to help you complete the installation of a Hackintosh system. But to understand it , we have to go back to that day. I was surfing the web and stumbled upon this video by Lao Zhang, where he used AI to build a Hackintosh with an NVIDIA graphics card. I thought, hey, I happen to have a machine right here I could try it on, so I spent some time using AI to build a Hackintosh with an NVIDIA card, and the results weren't bad. Originally , I planned to make a video sharing my whole build, but I realized that sharing.

my specific configuration process wouldn't be very helpful to others, so I thought, what if I could turn this workflow into a skill? This way, you could just feed the skill to an AI, and it could follow the process to configure different bootloaders for us, guiding us through the installation, and even helping with hardware configuration afterwards—a different kind of universal solution for Hackintosh, right? Because it could solve the various configuration issues and compatibility problems people encounter when installing a Hackintosh. We thought it would be simple; since I'd already finished the workflow, we just.

had to let the AI run it, and that would be that. But things went way beyond my imagination; I spent a full week just verifying the workflow and requirements , and even then, I couldn't guarantee it would work for your specific build. I felt like I’d dug a huge hole for myself , and I've already iterated through more than ten versions. Let me explain exactly what this skill is all about. Before we start, though, I hope you’ll give me a like, because this project is truly a labor of love. First, the skill is already open-sourced on GitHub; if you want to use it, just copy the content in this box, send it to your AI tool, and hit enter. This skill doesn't.

solve specific Hackintosh configuration issues directly; it’s a manual written for AI, guiding it to help us install a Hackintosh system by following a set workflow. Its core philosophy is that any step an AI can complete, we shouldn't have to do manually. You can think of it as an AI-driven script; it has a fixed workflow. When things go as planned, it follows the steps, but when an issue arises, it breaks from the process to guide the AI in solving the problem before returning to the standard procedure. I have divided the entire Hackintosh installation process into nine stages. You only need to handle enabling remote connection, plugging and unplugging the USB drive, restarting the.

computer, and installing macOS. Everything else is done by AI; you only need to respond when the AI asks a question. This entire skill was written using Cursor and GPT-4o. GPT's own capabilities are actually quite good, so where does the problem lie? Why did I spend so much time making revisions afterward? It’s because the abilities of different LLMs to read and execute this skill are uneven. I expected my workflow to be fixed and for the AI to follow it faithfully, but some AIs just love to improvise. Their abilities to troubleshoot configurations and fix hardware drivers also vary, which eventually led me to tell GPT directly:.

"Treat the AI using this skill as if it's a fool who can't get anything right ; you need to find a way to make it get it right." Because of this, I struggled for a long time and went through many revisions. Anyway, the progress of this skill is currently running quite well on the test machines I have on hand, but I don't have more hardware configurations , nor do I have enough tokens for different LLMs. So, if we want to keep improving it, I'll need everyone's help to test it together. If you encounter any problems while using this skill, you can post them directly to my GitHub project page or in the comment section of this video. I will collect these issues periodically and get them fixed.

Well then, I'll leave the rest for you all to experience for yourselves. I'm Moras, and I'll see you next time.

為了實現「只要 AI 能完成的步驟，人類就不用手動執行」的核心理念，作者將整個黑蘋果安裝過程拆解為九個階段，並將專案於 GitHub 完全開源。這份技能本質上是為 AI 量身打造的操作手冊，使用者在整個過程中只需要負責開啟遠端連線、插拔 USB 隨身碟、重開機等少數實體操作，其餘檔案配置與錯誤排查均交由 AI 主導推進。

安裝流程與 Steam 大螢幕體驗

完成應用安裝後，首次啟動需聯網自 GitHub 與 Valve 伺服器下載必要組件。若啟動遇到困難，作者建議可檢查開發者選項中的限制子進程設定。登入帳號後即可順利進入完全支援觸控的 Steam 大螢幕模式，使用者能自由下載遊戲並外接手把遊玩。此外，系統提供豐富的進階設定，例如建議以 720P 為基準調整解析度，並搭配縮放濾鏡與 60 幀上限；針對效能不足的情況，軟體亦內建三種插幀演算法與 LSFG 選項，但作者提醒插幀仍會消耗 GPU 資源，若核心已滿載則效果有限。

除了 Steam 平台外，DroidDeck 的野心相當龐大，它不僅支援導入 Epic Games、GOG 和 Amazon 等平台的遊戲庫，還內建了一套基於 Arch Linux ARM 的完整桌面環境。使用者可以透過觸控板手勢操作桌面終端機，軟體更預設整合了多款模擬器與應用商店，甚至允許自行上傳安裝包與設定 ROM 路徑。針對遊戲執行時可能遇到的花屏或圖形錯誤，作者也提醒使用者可在組件選單中切換不同的圖形驅動與 Proton 版本來改善相容性。
